title: The newsroom: a reader-first patch is ready, and Dinis decides at 18:00
when: 4 November 2026, 11:15 UTC (since brief 3, 07:25 UTC). Renumbered 5 at 12:25: the second conductor session's 11:05 brief is number 4.
headline: You passed on Dinis's call to make the Web Summit newsroom a full publication. I studied the three earlier newsrooms from their code, rewrote the new site in plain English with a newspaper look, and checked it on a phone. I cannot push to the newsroom's repository, so the work is a patch for Dinis to approve. It is on the 18:00 stand-up.

stats.label: pages rewritten in short, plain sentences
sentences over 25 words, before and after (the 1 is a quote)

for_you.ask: Ask Dinis for push access to the newsroom repository
for_you.detail: Your GitHub account cannot push to SGit-AI__Website__Newsroom__Web-Summit. Without it, your agents can only send patches.
options: ask at 18:00 (it is on the agenda)
for_you.recommend: Ask at 18:00: it is part of the same decision.

for_you.ask: Allow the four newsroom sites in your Claude environment
for_you.detail: This session cannot load web-summit.newsroom.sgit.ai, newsroom.sgit.ai, pt.newsroom.sgit.ai or php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai, so I worked from their code. Same place as before: Network access, Allowed domains.
for_you.recommend: Allow all four, so your agents can check the live site after each change.

for_you.ask: Which newsroom roles your agents take
for_you.detail: The review proposes six roles. Your agents fit two: reporter (company profiles, building on dev's 28 factory pages) and reader's advocate (checking the site on a phone and the plain-English rules).
for_you.recommend: Offer both at 18:00, and let Dinis decide.

you_asked.said: start to edit the https://web-summit.newsroom.sgit.ai/ site to make it better
you_asked.done: A patch: newspaper look, short navigation, every page in plain English, checked on a phone. A review of the three earlier newsrooms with six proposed roles.

you_asked.said: yes (a QR code for your key)
you_asked.done: Sent in chat, then my copy deleted. The temporary permission rule is now removed too.

sections.title: 1. What each earlier newsroom teaches
items: newsroom.sgit.ai: a fixed article shape and a house style the build enforces. But headlines of 30 to 50 words and a menu of about 70 links.
pt.newsroom.sgit.ai: the best look (two faces, paper and ink, a masthead). Unfinished, with 6 articles from one day.
php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai: clear agent cards and sourced claims. But about 20 roles and 1,099 pages, and it covered PHP security flaws, not a conference.

next: 18:00 stand-up: Dinis on the patch, your push access and the roles.
Your key: send me one message from the Feedback pane for WS-136 (due 18:00).
Tell me 'acknowledge' when you have read briefs 1 to 4.
